author: Discovery
description:
These investigations all involve suspected cartel ties. In one case, a woman acts aggressively and officers find a statue of Santa Muerte, a folk figure often associated in cartel cases with death symbolism, in her belongings, suggesting possible criminal connections. In another, a cartel tries to smuggle a shipment hidden in coconut oil across the border just before midnight. Officers also find 24 packages of contraband on a bus headed to Mexico. In a separate case, an elite team prepares to extradite a wanted cartel member back to Mexico. Finally, inspectors call firefighters to help cut into a truck carrying 85 bundles of meth tied to a cartel.#Discovery #ContrabandSeizedattheBorder
